data.title: Six Senses Residences The Palm
data.about:
Welcome to Dubai’s First-Ever Six Senses Branded Residences on the Palm Jumeirah by Select Group. 

The very definition of luxury, finesse and perfection, Six Senses Residences The Palm offers you a choice of 2 – 5 bedroom penthouses, sky villas and signature villas. Nestled on the West Crescent of the Palm Jumeirah, these homes have mesmerising views of the Arabian Gulf and the City’s skyline. An iconic residential destination, Six Senses Residences The Palm provides you with world-class amenities and direct access to beach and hotel facilities.

characteristics_module.title: Discover unparalleled luxury at Six Senses Residences The Palm, Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Signature Branded Residences – Elegantly designed homes infused with Six Senses’ signature hospitality and elevated lifestyle offerings.
  • Comprehensive Wellness Facilities – Access to Six Senses Place, a 60,000 sq. ft. wellness and lifestyle hub.
  • Sustainable Luxury Living – Residences crafted using renewable and locally sourced materials for eco-friendly elegance.
  • Prestigious Palm Jumeirah Location – Situated on Dubai's iconic Palm Jumeirah, offering stunning views and exclusivity.

location_tile.title: Six Senses Residences The Palm is nestled on the western crescent of Palm Jumeirah.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
The Palm Jumeirah is one of the world’s most desired addresses. This is the ultimate holiday destination and is close to The Palm Tower Viewing Deck, The Golden Mile, Nakheel Mall and Dubai Marina.

  • 7 mins – Nakheel Mall
  • 14 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 16 mins – Mall of Emirates
  • 26 mins – Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa
  • 30 mins – Dubai International Aiport
